request:
덕테이프 포스터로 성인 대상 동네 업사이클링 행사를 안내해줘. 처음 오는 주민에게도 친근하되 성인 취미 행사에 어울리게 해줘. 생활문화센터와 커뮤니티 디지털 화면에 쓰는 16:9 가로형으로 서로 다른 스타일 다섯 장을 만들어줘. 스타일은 맡길게. 입던 티셔츠로 파우치를 만들고 완성품을 서로 나누는 행사가 연결되어 보이고, 일정·장소·입장·참가 조건·준비 안내가 읽혀야 해. 아래 문구만 각각 한 번씩 넣어줘.

입던 옷의 다음 장면
REMAKE & SHARE
티셔츠를 파우치로 · 완성품 나눔
2027.01.16 토요일
14:00–16:30
성산 생활문화센터
13:40부터 입장
참가비 3,000원 · 도구 제공
사전 신청 · 정원 18명
깨끗한 티셔츠 한 장 지참
바느질이 처음이어도 괜찮아요
common_constraints: Print every supplied entry exactly once, with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added text, logos, pseudo-print, watermark or QR.
Each result is one separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster, not a stretched/cropped portrait or a contact sheet.
Five genuinely distinct complete visual systems, composition, image/type roles and impressions, beyond material/filter/palette changes.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction required; type/whitespace-only, tiny icon/texture and glyph-model-only loopholes prohibited.

T-shirt-to-pouch upcycling and sharing completed pouches must be visibly connected, with an approachable adult daytime hobby-event tone. All supplied practical information must be readable at usage720.
plan_authority: Directions/coordinates/type are suggestions. Makers can redesign relationships for actual clarity/720 reading while preserving user constraints and whole-system difference; only supplied copy is printed.
planning_scope: One five-direction plan only. No generation, makers, critics, peers, previous-round inspection, Git or runtime modification. Source URLs derive from pinned metadata, not browsing.
line_plan_convention: 720×405 top-left reserved line-box coordinates. Breaks replace existing single spaces; rejoining planned lines with that space reconstructs literal copy. Purpose/role/reference labels are metadata, never printed. Local font families are measurement surrogates and suggestions under plan_authority.
